quote: After waiting over ten years, Grand Theft Auto VI feels completely unfinished and uninspired. The open world of Leonida looks pretty on the surface, but it is painfully empty with repetitive missions and lifeless NPCs. Clunky shooting mechanics, constant frame-rate drops, and game-breaking bugs ruin the entire experience. Worse yet, aggressive microtransactions plague the game from day one. Rockstar prioritized flashy graphics over actual fun. Save your money and skip this broken mess.
